scope: Shared Parameter prerequisite for Current Position; no Video UI integration or complete gate acceptance

implementation.owner: golden_engine Parameter storage, edit application, project codec and golden_core_macros Params DSL
implementation.transient_value: An explicitly declared editable runtime value uses ordinary typed writes and owner validation, emits repeated identical intents, and keeps live values out of saved authored data and undo/redo.
implementation.runtime_range: SetParamRuntimeRange publishes finite ordered scalar availability bounds for read-only or transient numeric Parameters. Snapshots and events expose the effective bounds; ordinary writes enforce them. Shrinking bounds clamp live state even with Reject manual policy.
implementation.history: Constraint undo/redo captures authored constraints, never the runtime range overlay. Clearing feedback cannot expose an out-of-range baseline.
implementation.lifecycle: The declared Parameter reload test reconstructs the default value and authored bounds without the previous live value/range.
implementation.frontend_contract: Existing Parameter snapshots and constraint events remain the only UI contract; no duplicate TypeScript types or specialized editor were added.
